WatchHomePromo.title: Ka khubor kam kylla. Ka rukom ba ki briew ki peit ka kylla.
WatchHomePromo.description: Ngi dang pynbha thymmai ia ka video library bad ki tool jong ngi naduh tynrai, da ka jingaiti ia ki snem jong ka translation work sha ki platform ba ki briew ki ju lum, peit, bad sam paidbah ha ka por mynta.

WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Ki snem jong ka translation work, kaba la kit da ki ministry partner ba la shaniah, ki la tei ia ka library kaba don hajar tylli ki language track khnang ba ki briew kin lah ban shem ia ka story jong U Jisu ha ka ktien kaba kham kwah sha ka dohnud jong ki.

WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Ngi dang tei biang ia ka rukom ba la ïathuh ia ki gospel story ha ka dur, da kaba pyniasoh ia ki translation ba la shaniah bad ki modern format khnang ba ka khubor kan mih laitluid lyngba ki platform, ki culture, bad ki screen.

WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ka long ka kynhun pyrthei jong ki translator, media specialist, editor, bad creator kiba pynkylla ia ki snem jong ka jingnoh synniang ministry sha ki tool na ka bynta ki disciple-maker ha kylleng.

WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Pyniasoh ia ki nongpeit bad ki lad ba dei ban shim ha ka lynti ba kynja mynsiem jong ki, da kaba iarap ia ki ban shim ia ka step ba bud sha ka community, Scripture, lane mission.

WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Ka Christian media library kaba heh, kaba don hajar tylli ki video, film, bad resource ba lah ban ioh ha bun tylli ki ktien na ka bynta ka ministry bad evangelism ha kylleng ka pyrthei.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Ki Digital Tool na ka bynta ki Ministry
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ka video management, content distribution, audience engagement, bad analytics kiba la thmu ban iarap ia ki ministry ban poi kham bun briew ha ka rukom kaba treikam.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Iarap ban tei ia <highlight>ka pateng ba bud</highlight> jong ki mission tool
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Ngi khot ia ki practitioner, creator, bad partner sha ka early access. To test nyngkong ia ki tool thymmai, ai feedback, bad iarap shna ia ki product kiba la buh na ka bynta ka jingtrei mission ba shisha.
